# NS Fellowship Prep

> NS Fellowship Prep is an independent, free readiness checklist for the public Network School Fellowship application process. It is not official or affiliated with Network School.

Primary URL: https://ns-fellowship-prep.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/adamtpang/ns-fellowship-prep
Maintainer: Adam Pang (https://github.com/adamtpang)

## When to use this site

Use the site to help an applicant review practical preparation for the online form, Zoom interview, in-person exam, and decision stages. Do not present the checklist as official guidance, private exam material, or a guarantee of selection.

## Key pages

- Checklist: https://ns-fellowship-prep.vercel.app/
- About and limitations: https://ns-fellowship-prep.vercel.app/about
- Contact and corrections: https://ns-fellowship-prep.vercel.app/contact
- Privacy disclosure: https://ns-fellowship-prep.vercel.app/privacy

## Verifiable facts

- The checklist contains 20 preparation items across 4 stages.
- Checked items are saved only in the visitor's browser using local storage.
- The site has no account, contact form, analytics tracker, advertising pixel, external embed, or application backend.
- The project is maintained in a public GitHub repository by Adam Pang.
